This weapon's own split is unmeasured.": "假设值：重击蓄力取公布的 {published} 秒的三分之一（Tonfa 上实测的比例）：{charge} 秒蓄力，只受蓄力速度影响；之后 {swing} 秒挥砍，受攻速影响。这把武器自己的比例未实测。"

  "A glaive's heavy attack is the detonation of a thrown glaive, which is its own mode (a throw, detonated), so there is no standing heavy mode and a Tennokai window converts no swing.": "战刃的重击是把投出去的战刃引爆，这是它单独的模式（投掷后引爆），所以没有原地重击模式，Tennokai 窗口也不会把挥砍转换成重击。"
  "A glaive bounces off the bodies it cannot punch through: the body it was thrown into is its first bounce, and the last its count allows turns it for home. With no walls here, a glaive that passes every body flies its whole range and bounces off nothing. A quick throw is given the charged throw's count, the only one published, and the flight between bounces adds no time.": "战刃会从穿透不过去的敌人身上弹开：投中的那个敌人是第一次弹跳，弹跳次数允许的最后一次之后它就飞回来。这里没有墙，能穿过所有敌人的战刃会飞满射程，不弹跳。快速投掷沿用蓄力投掷的弹跳次数（只有它公开了），弹跳之间的飞行不计时间。"
  "A bounce explosion (Volatile Rebound, Volatile Quick Return) takes no combo multiplier and spends no combo (wiki); whether Killing Blow or any other heavy-attack card reaches it is unpublished, and here none does. Volatile Quick Return's +3 Blast Radius is put on the bounce explosion alone.": "弹跳爆炸（易爆反弹、易爆速返）不吃连击倍率，也不消耗连击（wiki）；一击必杀或其他重击 Mod 是否作用于它没有公开，这里都不作用。易爆速返的 +3 爆炸半径只加在弹跳爆炸上。"
  "A detonated glaive goes off on its way out, no further than the first body it cannot pass, and makes no bounce after that one: the fight does not wait for the bounces it could still have made.": "引爆的战刃在飞出途中爆炸，最远到第一个穿透不过去的敌人，之后不再弹跳：不会等它把还能打的弹跳打完。"
  "The glaive seeks enemies by itself (wiki, Volatile Rebound); here it flies straight and bounces where reflection takes it.": "这把战刃会自己寻找敌人（wiki，易爆反弹页面）；这里它直线飞行，按反射方向弹跳。"
  "How fast a thrown glaive comes back is unpublished: one left to return is taken to fly back over the same distance at its own speed, and a detonated one is in the hand at once.": "投出的战刃飞回来的速度没有公开：不引爆时按原速沿同样距离飞回计算，引爆后则立刻回到手上。"
  "A throw's own animation is unpublished: it is taken as one attack at the throw's listed rate, after the charge where there is one, and attack speed shortens it.": "投掷本身的动作时长没有公开：按投掷的面板攻速算一次攻击（蓄力投掷在蓄力之后），攻速会缩短它。"
  "Tennokai on a throw is not modelled as the game has it: the window pauses while the glaive flies and only a detonation spends it.": "投掷时的 Tennokai 没有按游戏里的方式建模：战刃飞行期间窗口会暂停，只有引爆才会消耗它。"
  "Melee Animosity counts a throw as a heavy attack that pays its bonus and spends no stack; here a throw is a light input.": "近战·憎恶把投掷算作重击，吃加成且不消耗层数；这里投掷按普通攻击输入处理。"
  "The throw forces Ragdoll (the module's ForcedProcs), a state this arena does not have.": "投掷会强制触发 Ragdoll（模块的 ForcedProcs），本场没有这个状态。"
  "Not modelled: the quick throw, which hovers over the first enemy for 3 s, strikes it three times and explodes by itself (wiki); only the charged throw is played here.": "未建模：快速投掷——它会悬停在第一个敌人上方 3 秒，打它三次后自行爆炸（wiki）；这里只有蓄力投掷。"
  "The detonation's 40% falloff and 3.6 m are the page's; the module states no falloff, and 4 m on the charged throw. Unmeasured.": "引爆的 40% 衰减和 3.6 米半径取自页面；模块写的是无衰减，蓄力投掷为 4 米。未实测。"
  "The Throw Recall Explosion's 12% crit chance is the module's, against 22% on every other quick-throw row; unmeasured.": "Throw Recall Explosion 的 12% 暴击率取自模块，而其他快速投掷行都是 22%；未实测。"
  "A throw's 50% chance to disarm is not modelled; nothing here is armed.": "投掷 50% 几率缴械未建模；本场没有持械的敌人。"
  "The Maggots a throw drops are not modelled: the page gives no damage and no radius for them.": "投掷掉落的蛆虫未建模：页面没有给出它们的伤害和半径。"
  "On a throw the innate Toxin never combines with modded elements (wiki); here it combines as on a swing.": "投掷时自带的毒素不与 MOD 元素复合（wiki）；这里按挥砍时一样复合。"
  "The quick throw's 450 Blast detonation is the module's, the same as its bounce explosion where every other glaive doubles it; unmeasured.": "快速投掷 450 爆炸的引爆伤害取自模块，与它的弹跳爆炸相同，而其他战刃都是两倍；未实测。"
  "A cast's length is unpublished: each cast here takes one second at 1.0x Casting Speed, which sets how often it hits and changes no single hit.": "一次施放的时长没有公开数据：这里每次施放按 1.0x 施放速度下 1 秒计算，它决定命中的频率，不改变任何一次命中的伤害。"
  "Energy is unlimited here: every cast costs 25, scaled by Efficiency, and nothing runs dry.": "这里能量无限：每次施放消耗 25（受技能效率影响），不会耗尽。"
  "The combo counter gains 20 once per cast that hits; here a cast earns it per body it hits, which is the same against one target.": "连击计数在每次命中的施放中只增加一次 20；这里按每个被命中的目标各加一次，单个目标时两者相同。"
  "Mass Vitrify's barrier, which this attack explodes, and Splinter Storm's amplification are not modelled.": "这次攻击可以引爆的广域玻璃化屏障，以及玻片风暴的增伤，都未建模。"
  "The Charged Throw's direct damage is the module's, the same as the quick throw's where every other glaive doubles it; unmeasured.": "蓄力投掷的直击伤害取自模块，与快速投掷相同，而其他战刃都是两倍；未实测。"
  "A gunblade's heavy attack fires, which is not modelled, so there is no heavy mode and a Tennokai window converts nothing.": "枪刃的重击是射击，未建模，所以没有重击模式，Tennokai 窗口也转换不出任何东西。"
  "This weapon's heavy attack is {what}, which is not modelled, so there is no heavy mode and a Tennokai window converts nothing.": "这把武器的重击是{what}，未建模，所以没有重击模式，Tennokai 窗口也转换不出任何东西。"
  "Not modelled: {passive}.": "未建模：{passive}。"
  "The wiki publishes no heavy attack figure for this weapon, so there is no heavy mode.": "wiki 没有公布这把武器的重击数值，所以没有重击模式。"
  "The wiki publishes no slide attack figure or duration for this weapon, so there is no slide mode.": "wiki 没有公布这把武器的滑行攻击数值或时长，所以没有滑行模式。"
  "The wiki gives this weapon combos of its own ({combos}), which replace the stance's and are not transcribed; the stance's (or its class's) are used instead.": "wiki 给这把武器配了专属连段（{combos}），会替换所装架式的连段，这里没有录入；改用架式（或其类别）的版本。"
  "The heavy attack is the infobox's {infobox}x; the class's heavy table implies {table}x. Unmeasured.": "重击按信息框取 {infobox}x；类别重击表对应 {table}x。未实测。"
  "The Dark Split-Sword splits into a pair of Dual Swords with their own stats and stance; only the Heavy Blade form is entered here.": "Dark Split-Sword 可以拆分成一对双剑，有自己的数值和架式；这里只录入了巨刃形态。"
  "Its Incarnon evolutions and Incarnon Form are not modelled.": "它的灵化进化和灵化形态未建模。"
  "A plain slam at the arming combo also activates its Incarnon Form; here only a heavy attack does, so a loop that slams without a heavy arms it later than in a mission, or never.": "连击达到开启倍率时，普通的震地攻击也能开启它的灵化形态；这里只有重击能开启，所以只震地不重击的打法会比实战更晚开启，或者根本开不了。"
  "Its {family} valence bonus is not modelled: the build cannot state the element and bonus this copy rolled, so it reads without one.": "它的 {family} 元素加成未建模：配装无法填写这一把随机到的元素和加成，所以按没有加成计算。"
  "THE OPENER IS A SLAM, and Seismic Wave pays it on the ability page. It is a swing here, so Seismic Wave pays it nothing and it reaches the body in front rather than a sphere": "**第一击是捶地**，技能页说 Seismic Wave 会加成它。这里按挥砍处理，所以 Seismic Wave 不加成，而且只打到面前的目标，不是一个球形范围"
  "two of the second input's five hits force Slash; the five land as one row here, so none of them is forced — the conservative direction": "第二次输入的五下里有两下强制切割；这里五下作为一行同时结算，所以一下都不强制——偏保守的方向"
  "The stance page gives this slide up to 5 hits on one target or 4 on several; the module and the ability page say 6. This entry lands 6, unmeasured.": "架式页写这个滑行对单体最多 5 下、对多个敌人 4 下；模块和技能页写 6 下。本条目按 6 下，未实测。"

  "It needs 40 shots to reach full accuracy (wiki); this entry uses the settled spread, so an early burst is tighter here than in game.": "需要 40 发之后才能达到最佳精度（wiki）；本条目用的是收紧后的散布，所以前段连射比游戏里更集中。"
  "Cantare Chorale: hitting enemies with the returning blades grants allies in range +20% reload speed for 30 s (wiki). The return is not fired and there are no allies here.": "Cantare Chorale：用回收的刀刃击中敌人，会给范围内的队友 30 秒 +20% 换弹速度（wiki）。这里不会回收刀刃，也没有队友。"
  "Chamber Cascade: a hit or a damaging status has a 4% chance to grant 100% ammo efficiency for 4 s (wiki). Reserves are infinite by default, so it adds nothing here.": "Chamber Cascade：命中或造成伤害的异况有 4% 几率获得 4 秒 100% 弹药效率（wiki）。备弹默认无限，所以这里不产生收益。"
  "Critical hits have a 6% chance to set the next shot's status chance to 500% (wiki). The engine does not model this crit-triggered status lock, so it procs at its card's 1%. It is most of the weapon; the number reads low.": "暴击有 6% 几率把下一发的触发几率设为 500%（wiki）。引擎没有建模这种暴击触发的异况锁定，所以只按卡面的 1% 触发。这是这把武器的主要部分；数字偏低。"
  "'DEATH KNELL', and it is most of the weapon: a weak-point hit grants 100% ammo efficiency, +0.5x final critical multiplier and +20% final status chance, stacking to 3, each stack lasting 2 seconds and refreshed by the next weak-point hit (wiki). This engine has no headshot-TRIGGERED buff — a crit is rolled for a hit and the body part is drawn beside it — so none of the three is applied, and the ammo half in particular is what makes a one-round magazine playable. Read this number as the weapon with its passive switched off": "「DEATH KNELL」，而且它就是这把武器的大部分：命中弱点会获得 100% 弹药效率、最终暴击倍率 +0.5x、最终触发几率 +20%，可叠加 3 层，每层持续 2 秒，并可被下一次弱点命中刷新（维基）。本引擎没有「爆头触发」的增益 —— 暴击是为这一次命中掷的，命中部位是在旁边另外抽的 —— 所以这三项一项都没有生效，而其中弹药那一半正是让一发弹匣能打得下去的原因。请把这个数字读作「关掉被动的这把武器」"
  "Enemies can shoot down the rockets (wiki); nothing shoots back here, so every rocket arrives.": "敌人可以打掉这些火箭（wiki）；这里没有东西会还击，所以每枚火箭都会命中。"
  "An enemy killed directly by it leaves a Gas cloud whose ticks deal half the killing shot's damage (wiki).   "In game the chain can route through corpses (wiki); here a body that dies leaves the formation, so in a long fight the chain reaches fewer enemies and the number reads low.": "游戏里连锁可以经由尸体继续跳（wiki）；这里死掉的目标会离开阵型，所以长时间战斗中连锁能到达的敌人更少，数字偏低。"
  "Fires only at full charge; an early release fires nothing. The sim always charges fully, so the number is the ceiling.": "只能满蓄力发射；提前松手什么都打不出来。模拟总是蓄满，所以数字是上限。"
  "Overdrive: a weak-point kill grants +100% fire rate, +100% ammo efficiency and -100% recoil for 8 s, and disables the alt-fire meanwhile (wiki).   "Its guaranteed knockback and ragdoll (wiki) are crowd control, not damage, and are not applied. The number is unaffected.": "它的必定击退和布娃娃效果（wiki）属于控制效果，不是伤害，所以未应用。数字不受影响。"
  "Projectiles bounce off surfaces (wiki); there are no walls here.": "弹体会从表面反弹（wiki）；这里没有墙。"
  "Target Analysis: each shot grants +4% flat critical and status chance, stacking to 5 for 2 s (wiki).   "Aiming raises a shield that blocks frontal projectiles, closing on a reload or a charge (wiki). Nothing shoots back here; the number is unaffected.": "瞄准时会展开一面挡下正面弹体的护盾，换弹或蓄力时收起（wiki）。这里没有东西会还击，数字不受影响。"
  "Bolts stick and fling bodies on a kill, and a flung body damages targets in its path (wiki). There is no ragdoll here, so against a crowd the number reads low.": "弩箭会钉在目标身上，击杀时把尸体甩飞，飞出的尸体会伤害沿途的目标（wiki）。这里没有布娃娃物理，所以面对人群时数字偏低。"
  "The charge is automatic and need not be held (wiki), as in the sim.": "蓄力是自动的，不需要按住（wiki），与模拟一致。"
  "Each shot lands in a small square around the aim point and can miss small targets (wiki); this entry uses the module's 1-1.2 degree spread for that square.": "每一发会落在瞄准点周围的一个小方阵里，面对小目标可能打空（wiki）；本条目用模块中 1–1.2 度的散布来表示这个方阵。"
  "Headshot kills from the bolt boost reload speed by 50% (wiki); a kill-triggered buff the engine does not model.": "弩箭直接伤害造成的爆头击杀会让换弹速度 +50%（wiki）；引擎没有建模击杀触发的增益。"
  "Headshot kills from the bolt boost reload speed by 50% (wiki); a kill-triggered buff the engine does not model. The page notes its forced Impact proc makes repeated headshots hard anyway.": "弩箭直接伤害造成的爆头击杀会让换弹速度 +50%（wiki）；引擎没有建模击杀触发的增益。页面也指出，它的必定冲击会让连续爆头很难。"
  "It cannot hold a charge (wiki): the shot fires once charged, as in the sim.": "它无法保持蓄力（wiki）：蓄满即发射，与模拟一致。"
  "Accuracy improves the longer it fires (wiki); this entry uses the settled spread.": "持续开火越久精度越高（wiki）；本条目用的是收紧后的散布。"
  "Landing a tracer round grants +50% absolute critical chance for 20 s, unaffected by mods (wiki).   "Firing the alt-fire without a full gauge still drains it (wiki); the sim fires only on a full gauge, so it never wastes one.": "充能条未满时使用副射击也会把它清空（wiki）；模拟只在满条时发射，所以从不浪费。"
  "Weak-point hits get +250% critical chance, additive with Point Strike (wiki). The engine has no headshot-only crit bonus, so the crit chance here is 40% where a headshot lands at 290%.   "+30% Movement Speed while aiming and the explosion's self-stagger are not read here.": "瞄准时 +30% 移动速度和爆炸造成的自身踉跄，这里不读取。"

  "Standard means this fight is claimed to represent most play, not that it is the fight you play: one tough, unaffiliated target, and a build that beats it transfers.": 「标准」是说这场战斗被判断为能代表大多数情况，不是说你平时就在打它：一个耐打、不属于任何派系的目标，打得赢它的配装能迁移到别处。
  "The target is a Thrax Centurion because a build that beats it transfers: it belongs to no faction, so no faction mod and no faction bonus reads on it; it carries Overguard, which most Warframe abilities cannot take off, so the weapon has to; it is armoured and tanky; it is immune to no element, so every proc lands; its weak points are the ordinary ones, 3x on the head and 1x elsewhere.": 选凶魂百夫长做目标，是因为打得赢它的配装能迁移：它不属于任何派系，派系 MOD 和派系加成都对它无效；它带超宏防护，大多数战甲技能扒不掉，只能靠武器；它有护甲，够肉；它不免疫任何元素，各种触发都能正常吃到；它的弱点分布是常见的，头部 3 倍、其他部位 1 倍。
  "Its flaws are stated rather than hidden: it carries no shield, its Overguard may sit high, and the spectral form it enters on death is switched off here.": 它的缺点也写在这里，不藏着：它没有护盾，超宏防护可能偏高，死后的灵体形态在这里是关掉的。
  "Standard means this fight is claimed to represent most play, not that it is the fight you play: a crowd of tough, unaffiliated targets, packed as close as every elemental area effect still reaches and no larger than holds them whole.": 「标准」是说这场战斗被判断为能代表大多数情况，不是说你平时就在打它：一群耐打、不属于任何派系的目标，站得刚好让每种元素范围效果都能打到邻居，方阵大小刚好装下它们。
  "The spacing decides whether splash or single-target damage wins: 3 m is where that ordering matches play, and it is the widest whole metre at which Electricity still reaches a neighbour.": 决定溅射还是单体胜出的是间隔：3 米时这个排序和实战一致，也是电还能打到相邻敌人的最大整米间隔。
  "One specific fight players run, measured as it is rather than as a stand-in for most play: a Demolisher a full squad meets, taken apart by one weapon.": 这是玩家实际会打的一场具体战斗，按它本来的样子来测，不代表大多数情况：一整支小队面对的爆破使，由一把武器单独拆掉。
  "One specific fight players run, measured as it is rather than as a stand-in for most play: the Eximus Corrupted Heavy Gunner of the Void Fissures, taken apart by one weapon.": 这是玩家实际会打的一场具体战斗，按它本来的样子来测，不代表大多数情况：虚空裂缝里的卓越者堕落重型机枪手，由一把武器单独拆掉。

  "Switching firing modes takes 3 s, can be interrupted and scales with reload speed (wiki); the sim never switches, so each mode is measured as the whole weapon and the switch costs nothing.": "切换射击模式需要 3 秒，可被打断，受换弹速度影响（wiki）；模拟从不切换，所以每个模式都按整把武器测量，切换没有代价。"

  "The +50% reload speed while sprinting is not modelled: the player stands still here (Gauss and Gauss Prime double it to +100%).": "冲刺时 +50% 换弹速度未建模：这里的玩家站着不动（Gauss 和 Gauss Prime 翻倍为 +100%）。"
  "The 0.8 s embed delay before the slug detonates, during which it pulls in enemies within 6 m, is not modelled.": "弹丸引爆前 0.8 秒的嵌入延迟未建模；期间它会把 6 米内的敌人拉过来。"
  "The 11-degree spread is not modelled; at zero distance all eleven pellets land.": "11 度散布未建模；零距离时十一颗弹丸全部命中。"
  "The 20-40 degree spread is not modelled; at zero distance all six pellets land.": "20–40 度散布未建模；零距离时六颗弹丸全部命中。"
  "The 5% life steal on headshots adds nothing here: there is nothing to heal.": "爆头附带的 5% 吸血在这里不产生收益：没有需要回复的生命。"
  "The 8-degree spread is not modelled; at zero distance all six missiles land on the one target.": "8 度散布未建模；零距离时六枚导弹全部命中唯一的目标。"
  "Accuracy also improves during the spool (wiki); this entry uses the settled spread, so an early burst is tighter here than in game.": "转膛过程中精度也会提升（wiki）；本条目用的是收紧后的散布，所以前段连射比游戏里更集中。"
  "The alt-fire spends the whole magazine to deploy a turret that shoots on its own, with a 75 Blast expiry blast (wiki, module). The engine has no deployed turret, so neither the turret nor the magazine it costs is counted.": "副射击会耗尽整个弹匣，部署一座自动射击的炮台，到期时爆炸造成 75 爆炸伤害（wiki、模块）。引擎没有可部署的炮台，所以炮台和它消耗的弹匣都未计入。"
  "The alt-fire only changes the zoom (wiki), so this weapon has one attack and no mode to choose.": "副攻击只调整倍率（wiki），所以这把武器只有一种攻击，没有可选的模式。"
  "The Archwing version is not offered: in space it fires a single 440-damage Impact/Heat projectile at 13% status, which is a different weapon.": "太空版本未提供：太空中它是一发 440 伤害的冲击/火焰弹、触发率 13%，属于另一把武器。"
  "The auto-spool ramp is not modelled: the rate is the spooled-up {rate}/s from the first shot, so a short burst is faster here than in game.": "自动转膛的爬升未建模：从第一发起就按转满的 {rate}/秒 计算，所以短点射比游戏里快。"
  "The Arch-Gun Deployer's five-minute cooldown is not modelled: in a mission the weapon is gone once its reserve runs dry; here it simply stops firing.": "空战枪投放器五分钟的冷却未建模：任务中备弹打空后这把枪就用不了了；这里只是停火。"
  "The battery discharge when the magazine empties, a 20 m pulse for 100 Impact, is not built yet. Its rule is published: base damage, faction damage and Firestorm apply; elemental and multishot bonuses do not, and blast-radius mods reach it. Its status is a 100% chance, not a forced proc. The number reads low.": "弹匣打空时的电池放电（20 米范围、100 冲击伤害）尚未实现。它的规则是公开的：受基础伤害、派系伤害和 Firestorm 影响，不受元素和多重射击加成影响，爆炸半径 MOD 对它有效。它的触发是 100% 几率，不是必定触发。数字偏低。"
  "The beam's cone, 'radial damage varying from 1 to 4 meters in a cone shape' (wiki), has no published damage figure and is not modelled. Only the direct beam is applied, so against anything the cone would catch the number reads low.": "光束的锥形范围（wiki：「1 到 4 米不等的锥形范围伤害」）没有公布伤害数值，未建模。这里只计光束直击，所以面对锥形能覆盖到的目标时数字偏低。"
  "The beam's 0.15 m thickness, the largest of any continuous weapon, is not modelled: the beam here is a ray, so a shot that would clip an enemy with its edge misses, and Heavy Caliber's accuracy penalty costs more than in game.": "光束 0.15 米的粗细（所有连续武器中最粗）未建模：这里的光束是射线，所以本该用边缘擦到敌人的一击会打空，Heavy Caliber 的精度惩罚也比游戏里代价更大。"
  "The Blight syndicate effect blinds enemies in a radius and opens them to finishers (wiki). It runs on a syndicate meter the sim does not track, and blindness is crowd control; it is not counted.": "Blight 集团特效会让一定范围内的敌人致盲，并可被处决（wiki）。它由模拟不追踪的集团能量驱动，致盲又属于控制效果；未计入。"
  "The Bullet Attractor deals no damage. Its value, redirecting enemy fire and letting a punch-through round hit twice, needs enemies that shoot back and a second target; the number is unaffected.": "子弹吸引力场本身不造成伤害。它的价值（引开敌人火力、让穿透弹命中两次）需要会还击的敌人和第二个目标，数字不受影响。"
  "The Burst Shot is not modelled; this entry carries only the Charged Shot.": "Burst Shot 未建模；本条目只有 Charged Shot。"
  "The wiki's Condition Overload catalog gives this weapon's lingering cloud its own row, 4100% of its base; that row is not entered here yet, so the cloud takes 100% and a status-stacking build reads low on it.": "wiki 的异况超量目录给这把武器的毒云单独一行，按其基础值的 4100%；这一行在这里还没有录入，所以毒云按 100% 计算，堆异况的配装在它身上数字偏低。"
  "The wiki's Condition Overload catalog gives this weapon's radial its own row, 164% of its base; that row is not entered here yet, so the radial takes 100% and a status-stacking build reads low on it.": "wiki 的异况超量目录给这把武器的爆炸单独一行，按其基础值的 164%；这一行在这里还没有录入，所以爆炸按 100% 计算，堆异况的配装在它身上数字偏低。"
  "The wiki's Condition Overload catalog gives this weapon's radial its own row, 200% of its base; that row is not entered here yet, so the radial takes 100% and a status-stacking build reads low on it.": "wiki 的异况超量目录给这把武器的爆炸单独一行，按其基础值的 200%；这一行在这里还没有录入，所以爆炸按 100% 计算，堆异况的配装在它身上数字偏低。"
  "The wiki's Condition Overload catalog gives this weapon's radial its own row, 250% of its base; that row is not entered here yet, so the radial takes 100% and a status-stacking build reads low on it.": "wiki 的异况超量目录给这把武器的爆炸单独一行，按其基础值的 250%；这一行在这里还没有录入，所以爆炸按 100% 计算，堆异况的配装在它身上数字偏低。"
  "The wiki's Condition Overload catalog gives this weapon's radial its own row, 333% of its base; that row is not entered here yet, so the radial takes 100% and a status-stacking build reads low on it.": "wiki 的异况超量目录给这把武器的爆炸单独一行，按其基础值的 333%；这一行在这里还没有录入，所以爆炸按 100% 计算，堆异况的配装在它身上数字偏低。"

  "Chain lightning is not modelled, and it is a third of the weapon: each hit rolls 0-3 extra strikes (30/35/17.5/17.5%), guaranteed after three failures, chaining twice within 10 m. There is one target here, so the number reads low against a crowd.": "连锁闪电未建模，而它占这把武器的三分之一：每次命中掷出 0–3 道额外闪电（30/35/17.5/17.5%），连续三次落空后必定触发，在 10 米内连锁两次。这里只有一个目标，所以面对人群时数字偏低。"
  "Chaining is not modelled, and it is what the weapon is for: the beam jumps to up to 3 enemies within 5 m of each other. There is one target here, so against a crowd the number reads low.": "连锁未建模，而这正是这把武器的用途：光束会在彼此 5 米内的最多 3 个敌人之间跳跃。这里只有一个目标，所以面对人群时数字偏低。"
  "The charge time is not modelled because the page publishes none: mods treat it as a charge weapon, but it fires at the listed 1.00/s. A real draw can only be slower, so the rate is a ceiling.": "蓄力时间没有公开，所以未建模：MOD 仍按蓄力武器对待它，但它按面板的 1.00/秒 开火。真实蓄力只会更慢，所以射速是上限。"
  "This form is called a Charged Shot but has a semi-auto trigger with no charge time, so it is paced as a slow semi-auto shot.": "这个形态叫 Charged Shot，但它是半自动扳机、没有蓄力时间，所以按慢速半自动射击计算。"
  "The Condition Overload bonus ignores damage falloff (the catalog's notes on this row).": "异况超量的加成无视伤害衰减（目录这一行的备注）。"
  "The Condition Overload bonus ignores damage falloff (the catalog's notes on both rows); here it falls off with the shot, so a status-stacking build at range reads low.": "异况超量的加成无视伤害衰减（目录在两行备注中都写明）；这里它会随子弹一起衰减，所以远距离堆异况的配装数字偏低。"
  "The cold field is not modelled, and it is most of the weapon: each grenade leaves a 1.5 m field dealing 20 Cold a second at 30% status, with no published duration. Only the grenade's 10 Impact is counted, so the number reads low.": "冰冻力场未建模，而它是这把武器的主体：每颗榴弹留下一个 1.5 米的力场，每秒 20 冰冻伤害、触发率 30%，没有公开的持续时间。这里只计榴弹本身的 10 冲击伤害，所以数字偏低。"
  "The Entropy syndicate effect detonates enemies and restores the wielder's Energy (wiki). It runs on a syndicate meter the sim does not track; it is not counted.": "Entropy 集团特效会引爆敌人并为持有者恢复能量（wiki）。它由模拟不追踪的集团能量驱动；未计入。"
  "the FIVE-KILL GATE is not modelled — in game this alt-fire has to be earned with five kills from the primary fire before it can be used at all, and this entry fires it from the first second": 五杀解锁条件尚未建模 —— 游戏里这个副射击必须先用主射击拿到五个击杀才能使用，而这个条目从第一秒就能开火
  "Its drawback, converting health to ammo (up to 5% of max health), is not modelled: nothing shoots back and the Tenno has no health here, so the rifle is shown without its cost.": "它的代价（把生命转换为弹药，最多消耗最大生命的 5%）未建模：这里没有东西会还击，Tenno 也没有生命值，所以展示的是没有代价的这把步枪。"
  "Its drawback, converting health to ammo, is not modelled: nothing shoots back and the Tenno has no health here, so the rifle is shown without its cost.": "它的代价（把生命转换为弹药）未建模：这里没有东西会还击，Tenno 也没有生命值，所以展示的是没有代价的这把步枪。"
  "The hip-fire half of the passive, +60% ammo efficiency: the sim aims, and reserves are infinite anyway.": "被动的腰射部分（+60% 弹药效率）：模拟是瞄准状态，而且备弹本来就无限。"
  "The Incarnon Form Bounce Explosion is not modelled; this form has more parts than this entry carries.": "Incarnon Form Bounce Explosion 未建模；这个形态的部件比本条目能装下的多。"
  "The Incarnon Form Embed AoE is not modelled; this form has more parts than this entry carries.": "Incarnon Form Embed AoE 未建模；这个形态的部件比本条目能装下的多。"
  "The Incarnon Form's charged shot is not modelled, and it is most of the form: 2,200 Heat with guaranteed status, 38% crit and 3.2x, with the beam's 5 m punch through. It costs 50 of the 350 Incarnon rounds, so one gauge is seven charged shots. The number reads low.": "灵化形态的蓄力射击未建模，而它是这个形态的主要输出：2200 火焰伤害，必定触发，暴击率 38%、3.2 倍，带与光束相同的 5 米穿透。每发消耗 350 灵化弹药中的 50 发，一管就是七发。数字偏低。"
  "The charged shot's explosion is not modelled either: 1,100 Heat in 3 m at 38% crit and 3.2x, falling off to 70% at the rim, needing no line of sight.": "蓄力射击的爆炸同样未建模：3 米内 1100 火焰伤害，暴击率 38%、3.2 倍，边缘衰减到 70%，不需要视线。"
  "The Incarnon form's bouncing secondary projectiles are not modelled: a stacked shot releases 2 to 5, each exploding on up to 3 bounces.": "灵化形态的弹跳次级弹体未建模：叠层的一发会放出 2 到 5 个，每个最多弹 3 次并各自爆炸。"
  "the Incarnon form's route to stacks is not modelled — entering grants 1 and leaving grants one per shell that was missing, on top of a free magazine refill, and played to the edge that is 2 x magazine - 1 stacks in one cycle": 灵化形态那条攒层路线尚未建模 —— 进形态给 1 层，出形态按进去时缺的每一发再给 1 层，还外送一次装满弹匣；打到极限是一个循环 2×弹匣−1 层
  "The Justice syndicate effect detonates a radial blast and heals the wielder (wiki). It runs on a syndicate meter the sim does not track; the blast is not counted.": "Justice 集团特效会引爆一次范围爆炸并治疗持有者（wiki）。它由模拟不追踪的集团能量驱动；这次爆炸未计入。"
  "The Lifted synergy is not modelled: the wiki gives up to 13 extra direct-hit instances against a Lifted enemy, and its alt-fire guarantees Lifted. Only the Lifted status is applied (Condition Overload counts it), so the primary reads low while the target is lifted.": "浮空联动未建模：wiki 写明打浮空目标时最多 13 次额外直击伤害，而它的副射击必定浮空。这里只应用了浮空状态（异况超量会计入），所以目标浮空期间主射击数字偏低。"
  "The lingering flames the grenades leave are not modelled: the page gives 11 s of damage but no per-tick figure. The number reads low.": "榴弹留下的持续火焰未建模：页面给出持续 11 秒，但没有每跳数值。数字偏低。"
  "the LOADOUT, not what the wielder is doing: off means a full one, which is what the board is scored under. On, this weapon is the only one carried — the Vasto's Lone Gun pays its \"With No Primary Equipped\" half, and every \"On Equip from Primary\" or \"while Holstered\" clause becomes impossible rather than merely unmodelled": 配装本身，而不是使用者在做什么：关闭时表示带着完整的一套武器，榜单也是按这个跑分的。开启后这把枪就是身上唯一的武器——瓦斯托的「孤枪」会付出它「未装备主武器时」的那一半，而所有「从主武器切换时」「收枪状态下」的词条则从「没做建模」变成「根本不可能触发」
  "Lower zoom levels are not modelled: the scope always sits at its top level and its best buff.": "较低的变焦档位未建模：瞄准镜始终在最高档，吃最好的加成。"
  "A Mercy kill grants +100% damage and multishot for 20 s, refreshed on each Mercy, which doubles the weapon. This fight cannot perform a Mercy, so the number reads low.": "慈悲击杀会获得 20 秒 +100% 伤害与多重射击，每次慈悲都会刷新，相当于把武器翻倍。本场无法执行慈悲处决，所以数字偏低。"
  "The Microwave status enlarges the body part that was shot (wiki). It deals no damage and has no entry in the engine; its effect is an aiming aid the sim does not use.": "微波异况会放大被击中的身体部位（wiki）。它本身不造成伤害，引擎里也没有对应条目；它的作用是瞄准辅助，模拟用不上。"
  "The partial charge is a separate entry; in game both are the same trigger released at different moments.": "半蓄力射击是一个独立条目；游戏里两者是同一个扳机在不同时刻松开。"
  "The pellet count spools from 1 to 12, and this entry fires 12 from the first shot. The fire-rate spool is modelled and the pellet spool is not, so a short burst reads high.": "弹丸数从 1 爬升到 12，本条目从第一发起就打 12 颗。射速爬升已建模，弹丸数爬升未建模，所以短点射数字偏高。"
  "The Purity syndicate effect heals and cleanses the wielder and nearby allies (wiki). There is no health and no ally here; the number is unaffected.": "Purity 集团特效会治疗持有者与附近队友并清除异况（wiki）。这里没有生命值，也没有队友，数字不受影响。"
  "The second zoom level is not modelled. On this weapon it is a trade, not a buff: 3.5x gives +100% damage, +3 m explosion radius and -75% fire rate, half the sustained DPS for a much bigger single hit. This entry is the first level.": "第二档变焦未建模。在这把武器上它是取舍，不是加成：3.5x 给 +100% 伤害、+3 米爆炸半径和 −75% 射速，用一半的持续 DPS 换一发大得多的单发。本条目是第一档。"
  "The Sequence syndicate effect turns damage dealt into shields for the wielder and nearby allies (wiki). There are no shields and no allies here; the number is unaffected.": "Sequence 集团特效会把造成的伤害转化为持有者与附近队友的护盾（wiki）。这里没有护盾，也没有队友，数字不受影响。"
  "The Void proc's reset of Sentient and Shadow Stalker damage adaptation is not modelled.": "虚空异况对 Sentient 与暗影 Stalker 伤害适应的重置未建模。"
  "The Single Rocket Explosion is not modelled; this entry carries only the Single Rocket Impact.": "Single Rocket Explosion 未建模；本条目只有 Single Rocket Impact。"
  "The Toxin embed, a second attack dealing damage over 3 s on top of the hit (page), is not modelled; only the hit is carried.": "毒素嵌入（命中之外再用 3 秒造成伤害的第二段攻击，页面）未建模；只计命中本身。"
  "The Truth syndicate effect detonates a radial blast that strips some armour (wiki). It runs on a syndicate meter the sim does not track; the blast is not counted.": "Truth 集团特效会引爆一次削减部分护甲的范围爆炸（wiki）。它由模拟不追踪的集团能量驱动；这次爆炸未计入。"
  "The Uncharged Shot is not modelled; this entry carries only the Charged Shot.": "Uncharged Shot 未建模；本条目只有 Charged Shot。"
  "the aimed target": "被瞄准的目标"
  "The alt-fire cannot be reloaded early to skip its delay, and Kinetic Ricochet does not affect it; the sim does not interrupt reloads, so neither changes anything here.": "副射击不能提前换弹来跳过延迟，Kinetic Ricochet 也对它无效；模拟不打断换弹，所以两者在这里都没有影响。"
  "The alt-fire needs four rounds and reloads instead when there are fewer; the sim fires it whenever the mode is chosen, so a low magazine does not force a reload here.": "副射击需要弹匣里有四发，不够时会改成换弹；模拟只要选了这个模式就照打，所以弹匣见底时不会被强制换弹。"
  "The alt-fire cycles four quill types, Poison, Fire, Electric and Ice; this entry is the Poison one. The others differ in element, and two in physical damage (40 against 36), so a build around another quill reads about a tenth low.": "副射击在四种刺之间切换：毒素、火焰、电击、冰冻；本条目是毒素。其余几种元素不同，其中两种物理伤害也不同（40 对 36），所以围绕其他刺的配装数字大约偏低十分之一。"
  "The alt-fire cycles four quill types, Poison, Fire, Electric and Ice; this entry is the Poison one. The others differ in element, and two in physical damage, so a build around another quill is not exactly this number.": "副射击在四种刺之间切换：毒素、火焰、电击、冰冻；本条目是毒素。其余几种元素不同，其中两种物理伤害也不同，所以围绕其他刺的配装并不正好是这个数字。"
  "The alt-fire prevents zoom, so Hydraulic Crosshairs and Sharpened Bullets do not work on it (page); this entry does not apply that limit, so with those mods it reads high.": "副射击无法瞄准，所以 Hydraulic Crosshairs 和 Sharpened Bullets 对它无效（页面）；本条目没有应用这道限制，所以带这些 MOD 时数字偏高。"
  "The alt-fire sweeps both beams across the front (wiki); the sim fires a fixed ray, so the number is the ceiling against one target and reads low against a line.": "副射击会让两道光束在正前方来回扫（wiki）；模拟发射一条固定射线，所以对单个目标数字是上限，对一排目标数字偏低。"
  "The alt-fire detonates the arrow mid-flight; the sim lets it land, so choosing when to burst it is not modelled.": "副射击可以让箭在半空引爆；模拟让它落地，所以「何时引爆」这个选择未建模。"
  "The area damage can headshot, which the page marks as a bug; the sim applies headshots to the direct hit only, so the blast is never a headshot here.": "范围伤害可以爆头，页面把它标为 bug；模拟只对直击应用爆头，所以这里的爆炸不会算爆头。"
  "The arrow also throws appendages that grab enemies within 9 m and drag them in, dealing 90 damage each (module). The engine carries one explosion per attack, so neither the pull nor the damage is counted.": "这支箭还会甩出触手，抓住 9 米内的敌人并拖过来，每个造成 90 伤害（模块）。引擎每次攻击只带一次爆炸，所以拖拽和伤害都未计入。"
  "The barb's 0.9 s eruption delay is not modelled: the explosion arrives with the shot, so a short fight gets its damage early.": "倒刺 0.9 秒的爆发延迟未建模：爆炸与命中同时到达，所以短时间的战斗拿到伤害的时间偏早。"
  "The beacon exists to grant the primary fire +50% absolute critical chance and homing, which the engine cannot carry from one mode to another. On its own it is a three-damage dart.": "信标的作用是给主射击 +50% 绝对暴击率和追踪，而引擎无法把它们从一个模式带到另一个模式。单独使用时，它只是一根 3 点伤害的飞镖。"
  "the beam CHAINS to 2 more enemies within 9 m at 50% of the main beam's damage each — one target here, so it is worth exactly nothing (UNMODELLED.md §one target). It is the largest thing this weapon does in a room and the reason it was nerfed from 4 chains to 2": 光束会连锁到 9 米内另外 2 个敌人，各承受主光束 50% 的伤害 —— 这里只有一个目标，所以它的价值恰好为零（UNMODELLED.md §单目标）。这是这把武器在一个房间里最大的作用，也是它从 4 段连锁被削到 2 段的原因
  "the beam's 29 m range and its pinpoint accuracy, which this fight has no distance to spend": "光束 29 米的射程和它的极高精度 —— 这场战斗没有距离可以消耗它们"
  "The blades ricochet off surfaces (wiki); there are no walls here.": "锯片会从表面反弹（wiki）；这里没有墙。"
  "The charged alt-fire is not modelled: a full 10-stack blob over 2 s, for 10 ammo.": "蓄力副射击未建模：用 2 秒蓄出一团满 10 层的粘液，消耗 10 发弹药。"
  "Unpublished: how far an Incarnon pile's explosion grows with its stacks; every pile here goes off at the one-stack 0.3 m.": "未公开：灵化形态一堆粘液的爆炸范围随层数增长多少；这里每一堆都按 1 层的 0.3 米爆炸。"
  "blob": 粘液弹
  "Unmeasured: a shot already over the cap (multishot over {cap}) is read as holding the pile at {cap} and waiting 1.5 s, refreshed by each later shot, so steady fire never sets it off.": "未实测：一发就超过上限（多重射击高于 {cap}）时，按「这堆停在 {cap} 层、等待 1.5 秒」计算，之后每一发都会刷新等待，所以持续射击时一直不会引爆。"
  "Unmeasured: a shot that crosses the cap is read as setting the pile off at once for {cap} stacks, the rest lost.": "未实测：一发跨过上限时，按「立即以 {cap} 层引爆、多出的层作废」计算。"
  "Unmeasured: how many stacks a shot lays. Read as floor(multishot), the count the Grimoire's multishot buys; rolling the fraction would lay more.": "未实测：一发打几层。这里按 floor(多重射击) 计算，与 Grimoire 的多重射击规则一致；如果小数部分按概率取整，层数会更多。"
  "Unmeasured: the explosion's falloff is read as 70%, from the page's bug note, rather than the 30% in its table.": "未实测：爆炸衰减按 70% 计算（来自页面的 bug 说明），而不是表格中的 30%。"
  "Unmeasured: when a body dies, its pile is read as staying where it stood and going off on whoever is there.": "未实测：目标死亡时，按「这堆留在原地、到时对站在那里的目标爆炸」计算。"
  "Unmeasured: a pile is read as 200 a stack, the base form's linear scaling applied to the Incarnon explosion.": "未实测：这里按每层 200 线性叠加计算，即把基础形态的叠加方式套用到灵化形态的爆炸上。"
  "Unmeasured: the explosion's falloff is read as 70%, the base form's bug note applied to this form.": "未实测：爆炸衰减按 70% 计算，即把基础形态的 bug 说明套用到这个形态上。"
  "the board would not take this build, so nothing was sent": 榜单不会收这套配装，所以没有提交
  "the seat the open build sits in": 当前打开的这套配装所在的位置
  "another build acting in this fight": 这场战斗里另一套正在出手的配装
  "the whole squad — {n} builds acting together, so it is not a board figure": 整队合计 —— {n} 套配装一起出手，所以这个数不是榜单口径
  "every figure but DPS is {who}'s — DPS is the whole fight's": 除 DPS 外每一项都是 {who} 的；DPS 是整场的
  "a Guardian Eximus nearby gives its allies 90% damage reduction. It does NOT reach Overguard, so a target with a pool in front of it loses that pool at full speed and then takes a tenth": 附近有守护者卓越者时，它的同伴获得 90% 伤害减免。这个减免不作用于超宏防护，所以带超宏防护的目标会先按原速掉完超宏防护，之后才只吃十分之一
  "Ancient Protector aura": 远古守护者光环
  "an Ancient Protector nearby covers its allies in Overguard worth 800% of their maximum health. A body with Overguard of its own is excluded by name, so this does nothing to an Eximus": 附近有远古守护者时，它的同伴会获得相当于自身最大生命 800% 的超宏防护。维基点名排除了本来就自带超宏防护的单位，所以对卓越者无效
  "Guardian aura": 守护者光环
  "the body the weapon was on": 武器瞄准的那一具
  "the bonus this copy came out of its Lich with — added as the weapon's own BASE damage, so elemental mods and status scale with it": 这把枪从它的 Lich 那里带出来的加成——作为武器自身的基础伤害加上去，所以元素 MOD 和异常都会跟着放大
  "Not offered here: the bow-exclusive Thunderbolt, which on this weapon turns every bolt into a grenade, a second damage source.": "这里不提供：弓专属的 Thunderbolt，它会把这把武器的每支弩箭变成一颗手雷，是一整个第二伤害来源。"
  "The bubble holds what it catches until it collapses (wiki); crowd control, and enemies here neither move nor stop.": "气泡会困住抓到的东西直到坍缩（wiki）；这是控制效果，这里的敌人既不会移动也不会被定住。"
  "The bubbles explode 0.6-0.8 s after landing, which can let enemies leave the radius (page); here the blast resolves on impact, so nothing escapes.": "气泡在落地 0.6–0.8 秒后爆炸，敌人可能趁机离开范围（页面）；这里命中即结算，所以没有东西能躲开。"
  "the build and its rivens — no fight and no measurement, so opening it leaves the reader's own scenario untouched":
    只有这套配装和它的裂罅 —— 不带场景，也不带测量结果，所以对方打开它，他自己的场景设置不会被动过。
  "The burst can be cancelled with a quick melee to spend less than a full magazine; the sim never does.": "这轮连射可以用快速近战取消，从而不必打完整个弹匣；模拟从不这样做。"
  "The burst can be interrupted by a quick melee, a roll or a weapon swap; the sim does none of those, so it always runs to the end.": "这轮连射可以被快速近战、翻滚或换武器打断；模拟都不做，所以总是打完。"
  "The burst empties the magazine, and this entry fires a fixed 21 rounds, the unmodded magazine. Magazine mods make the real burst longer, so a build with one reads low.": "这轮连射会打空弹匣，本条目固定打 21 发，即未改装的弹匣。弹匣 MOD 会让真实连射更长，所以带这类 MOD 的配装数字偏低。"
  "The burst empties the magazine, and this entry fires a fixed 6 rounds, the unmodded magazine. Magazine mods lengthen the burst (page), so a build with one reads low.": "这轮连射会打空弹匣，本条目固定打 6 发，即未改装的弹匣。弹匣 MOD 会让连射变长（页面），所以带这类 MOD 的配装数字偏低。"
  "The burst empties the magazine, and this entry fires a fixed count, the unmodded magazine. Magazine mods lengthen the burst (page), so a build with one reads low.": "这轮连射会打空弹匣，本条目固定打未改装的弹匣数量。弹匣 MOD 会让连射变长（页面），所以带这类 MOD 的配装数字偏低。"
  "the by-round reload is not modelled — 0.8 s to start, 0.4 s a shell, 0.5 s to finish, interruptible at any point, and the sim reloads the whole magazine in one 3.7 s block": 逐发装填尚未建模 —— 起手 0.8 秒、每发 0.4 秒、收尾 0.5 秒，中途随时可打断，而模拟把整个弹匣算成一次 3.7 秒的装填
  "the by-round reload is not modelled — this weapon refills a shell at a time and the reload can be interrupted, and the sim reloads the whole magazine": 逐发装填尚未建模 —— 这把枪一次装一发、装填过程可被打断，而模拟一次装满整个弹匣
  "the by-round reload is now modelled — what is NOT is the INTERRUPTION: in game you can fire mid-reload and keep the shells you have loaded, and here a reload runs to the end": 逐发装填已经建模 —— 还没建模的是「打断」：游戏里可以装到一半开火、已经上膛的那几发算数，这里一次装填会走完
  "The card omits a requirement: the +33% Direct Damage per Status Type pays only with Energy Max 200 or higher, and nothing below it.": "卡面漏写了一个条件：每种异况 +33% 直接伤害只在能量上限 200 或以上时生效，低于 200 完全不生效。"
  "The card says Sprint Speed 1.2 or higher; the effect requires 1.1, so it pays on Warframes the card excludes. Amalgam Serration alone carries any Warframe past it.": "卡面写冲刺速度 1.2 或以上，实际只需 1.1，所以在卡面排除的战甲上也生效。单装「并合 膛线」就能让任何战甲达标。"
  "the card states this and the game does not do it — measured, and the simulation matches the game rather than the card": 卡面写了这一条，而游戏并不执行 —— 实测所得，模拟器跟随的是游戏而不是卡面
  "The charged shot travels 26 m (wiki), which is not entered, so it reaches a target at any distance.": "蓄力射击飞行 26 米（wiki），这一点未录入，所以任何距离的目标都能命中。"
  "The cloud confuses enemies in it, turning them on each other (wiki); crowd control, and enemies here neither turn nor stop.": "毒云会让其中的敌人陷入混乱、互相攻击（wiki）；这是控制效果，这里的敌人既不会倒戈也不会停下。"
  "The cloud arrives 1 s after the dart lands (wiki); here it resolves on impact, so nothing walks out of it.": "毒云在飞镖落地 1 秒后才出现（wiki）；这里命中即结算，所以没有东西能走出去。"
  "The cloud's Condition Overload term is 50 against its own base of 20, the catalog's 250%; that is not entered here, so it takes 100% and a status-stacking build reads low on it.": "毒云的异况超量为 50，而它自身的基础值是 20，即目录中的 250%；这一点这里没有录入，所以按 100% 计算，堆异况的配装在它身上数字偏低。"
  "The companion fires this weapon: it picks its targets, fires when it decides, and stops while reviving or out of range. Here it fires continuously at one target, so the number is the ceiling.": "这把武器由同伴开火：它自己选目标、自己决定何时开火，复苏或超出范围时会停火。这里它对一个目标持续开火，所以数字是上限。"
  "The cone is 2 m thick (wiki); the sim fires a ray with no width.": "锥形范围有 2 米厚（wiki）；模拟发射的射线没有宽度。"
  "The damage type rotation is averaged: the weapon deals 130 of one type at a time, cycling Impact, Puncture, Slash, and this entry splits it evenly. Total damage and status mix are exact; armour is not, because mitigation applies per instance.": "伤害类型轮换按平均计算：这把武器每次打 130 点单一类型，按冲击、穿刺、切割循环，本条目则平均分成三份。总伤害和异况比例是准确的；护甲减伤不准确，因为减伤按每次伤害分别计算。"
  "The damage type rotation is averaged: the weapon deals 160 of one type at a time, cycling Impact, Puncture, Slash, and this entry splits it evenly. Total damage and status mix are exact; armour is not, because mitigation applies per instance.": "伤害类型轮换按平均计算：这把武器每次打 160 点单一类型，按冲击、穿刺、切割循环，本条目则平均分成三份。总伤害和异况比例是准确的；护甲减伤不准确，因为减伤按每次伤害分别计算。"
  "A dart that pierces an enemy deals it only 1 tick of the damage over time (page); not modelled either.": "飞镖穿过的敌人只吃 1 跳持续伤害（页面）；同样未建模。"
  "The dart's 1.5 s explosion delay is not modelled: the blast arrives with the dart, so a short fight gets its damage early.": "飞镖 1.5 秒的爆炸延迟未建模：爆炸与飞镖同时到达，所以短时间的战斗拿到伤害的时间偏早。"
  "The discharge also strips Sentient and Shadow Stalker damage resistances; no target here has any.": "放电还会移除 Sentient 和暗影 Stalker 的伤害抗性；这里没有目标带有这种抗性。"
  "The duplex trigger is not modelled: one pull fires two rounds in game, and this entry paces one per pull.": "双发扳机未建模：游戏里扣一次发射两发，本条目按每次一发计算。"
  "the elite variant: more health, and a pool of Overguard in front of it": 卓越者变体：更高生命，且生命前面还有一层超宏防护
  "the target a squad of this size meets — it is a fatter enemy, not more guns: one weapon still fires, and what is ranked is how much of it yours takes off": 这个人数的小队会遇到的目标——它只是更厚的敌人，不是更多的枪：开火的仍然只有一把武器，排名比的是你这一把能把它削掉多少
  "The embedded detonation also forces a ragdoll, which is not damage and is not applied.": "嵌入后的引爆还会必定造成布娃娃效果，它不是伤害，未应用。"
  "The escalating ammo cost the wiki lists under Bugs (2/2/2/3/3/4/6 through a magazine, and -1 damage per extra ammo) is not modelled, so the number reads slightly high.": "wiki 列在 Bugs 里的递增弹药消耗（一个弹匣内依次为 2/2/2/3/3/4/6，每多耗 1 发伤害 −1）未建模，所以数字略偏高。"
  "The explosion staggers enemies, opening them to finishers and stealth multipliers (wiki); there is no melee and no stealth here.": "爆炸会让敌人踉跄，可被处决并吃到潜行加成（wiki）；这里没有近战，也没有潜行。"
  "The explosion arrives 0.6 s after the bolt lands, which lets an enemy walk out of it (page); here it resolves on impact, so nothing escapes.": "爆炸在弩箭落地 0.6 秒后才发生，敌人可以趁机走出范围（页面）；这里命中即结算，所以没有东西能躲开。"
  "The explosion's +9 s status duration is applied before other percentage duration bonuses (page), and is not modelled.": "爆炸的 +9 秒异况持续时间会在其他百分比持续时间加成之前生效（页面），未建模。"
  "The catalog says the explosion takes Condition Overload computed on the direct hit's base, 200 against the radial's own 60. That base is not entered, so the radial takes none and a status-stacking build reads low on it.": "目录写明爆炸会吃异况超量，并按直击的基础伤害计算（200，而爆炸自身为 60）。这个基数没有录入，所以爆炸不吃这一项，堆异况的配装在它身上数字偏低。"
  "The explosion's falloff is not modelled; the one target stands at the centre and always takes the full 2,000, never the 1,400 at the rim.": "爆炸衰减未建模；唯一的目标站在中心，始终吃满 2000，不会是边缘的 1400。"
  "The explosion's falloff is not published, so it is not modelled; the target stands at the centre and takes the full 228.": "爆炸衰减没有公布，所以未建模；目标站在中心，吃满 228。"
  "The explosion's falloff is not published, so it is not modelled; the target stands at the centre and takes the full 30.": "爆炸衰减没有公布，所以未建模；目标站在中心，吃满 30。"
  "The explosion's forced ragdoll and the alt-fire's forced knockdown on embed are crowd control; enemies here do not move, so neither applies.": "爆炸的必定布娃娃效果和副射击嵌入时的必定击倒都是控制效果；这里的敌人不会移动，所以都不适用。"
  "Whether a lingering field's tick (the Torid's cloud) triggers an extra hit is stated by neither wiki, so it does not here.": "持续力场的跳伤（例如 Torid 的毒云）是否触发额外伤害，两份 wiki 都没有写明，所以这里不触发。"
  "The fan has a 'very wide spread' (wiki) but the module gives a cone of zero; the module's figure is used, so every knife lands on the reticle here.": "扇形有「非常宽的散布」（wiki），但模块给的锥角是零；这里采用模块的数值，所以每把飞刀都落在准星上。"
  "The page lists as a bug that the field is disabled entirely against enemies with both shields and armor, or with Overguard. Against such a target the 2,250 above is zero.": "页面把这一条列为 bug：对同时有护盾和护甲、或带超宏防护的敌人，力场完全失效。对这样的目标，上面的 2250 是零。"
  "the fight these numbers are measured in — the quick calc runs the Simulator's own scenario, so switch it there and every chip follows": 这些数字是在哪场战斗里测出来的 —— 快速计算跑的就是模拟器当前的场景，去那边切换，每个标签都会跟着变
  "the fight": "这场战斗"
  "the fight's": 跟随这场战斗
  "The first zoom's -50% recoil and +2 m punch through are not read here.": "第一档变焦的 −50% 后坐力和 +2 米穿透，这里不读取。"
  "The gauge also fills by blocking attacks, 10% a second for 2 s (wiki); nothing attacks the wielder here, so only the kill route is modelled.": "充能条也能靠格挡攻击填充，每秒 10%、持续 2 秒（wiki）；这里没有东西攻击使用者，所以只建模了击杀这条途径。"
  "The grenades are detonated by hand with the alt-fire, with no arming delay (wiki). The sim has no second trigger, so each grenade detonates on landing: the ceiling for a player who detonates at once. Laying several and detonating them together is not modelled.": "榴弹由副射击手动引爆，没有解除保险延迟（wiki）。模拟没有第二个扳机，所以每颗榴弹落地即爆，这是立即引爆的玩家能达到的上限。先布置多颗再一起引爆的打法未建模。"
  "The grenades are earned by dealing damage with the primary fire, and the alt-fire is locked until the meter is full (wiki).   "The grenades arm only after 7.5 m and deal much less damage without exploding (wiki).   "The guaranteed Impact proc reaches only 14 m but is applied at every distance here, so past 14 m the number reads slightly high.": "必定触发的冲击只在 14 米内生效，但这里在任何距离都计算，所以超过 14 米时数字略偏高。"
  "The guaranteed Impact proc reaches only 29 m but is applied at every distance here; past 29 m the damage is already at its falloff floor.": "必定触发的冲击只在 29 米内生效，但这里在任何距离都计算；超过 29 米时伤害本来就已衰减到下限。"
  "The guaranteed Impact proc reaches only 18 m (wiki) but is applied at every range here, so further out the number reads high by one forced proc.": "必定触发的冲击只在 18 米内生效（wiki），但这里在任何距离都计算，所以更远时数字偏高，偏高一次必定触发。"
  "The guaranteed Impact proc reaches only 9 m, scaling with Projectile Speed (wiki); it is applied at every range here, so further out the number reads high by one forced proc.": "必定触发的冲击只在 9 米内生效，距离随弹速变化（wiki）；这里在任何距离都计算，所以更远时数字偏高，偏高一次必定触发。"
  "The harpoon pulls enemies in, knocks them down, grounds flyers and interrupts casting (wiki); all crowd control, and enemies here are neither moved nor interrupted.": "鱼叉会把敌人拉近并击倒、把飞行单位拽下来、打断施法（wiki）；这些都是控制效果，这里的敌人既不会被移动也不会被打断。"
  "The harpoon reels the target in and holds it (wiki); enemies here are neither moved nor held, so the mode's purpose adds nothing.": "鱼叉会把目标拉近并定住（wiki）；这里的敌人既不会被移动也不会被定住，所以这个模式的作用不产生收益。"
  "The beam's charge ramp is not modelled: its damage climbs to 2.5x the longer the trigger is held, resetting on release or on a charged shot. The beam here is scored at its lowest.": "光束的蓄能爬升未建模：按住越久伤害越高，最高 2.5 倍，松开或打出蓄力射击时重置。这里的光束按最低值计算。"
  "Hip-fire recoil is not modelled; the page notes the burst kicks much harder from the hip, and the sim has no recoil.": "腰射后坐力未建模；页面指出腰射时连射的后坐力大得多，而模拟没有后坐力。"
  "The horizontal spread is not modelled; at zero distance all eight projectiles land.": "水平散布未建模；零距离时八发弹体全部命中。"
  "The in-game falloff display is wrong on this weapon (page): it shows 13-22 m, and full damage holds to about 28 m. The 26-52 m entered here is the module's and infobox's.": "这把武器在游戏里显示的衰减距离是错的（页面）：显示为 13–22 米，实际满伤害可以保持到约 28 米。这里录入的 26–52 米来自模块和信息框。"
  "the innate INFINITE punch-through is not modelled — this fight has one target, and a wave that passes through a corridor of enemies is most of what this weapon is": "自带的无限穿透尚未建模 —— 这场战斗只有一个目标，而一道波穿过整条走廊的敌人才是这把武器的大半价值"
  "the innate infinite body punch-through is not modelled — this fight has one target, so it changes no number, and it is why Dual-Mode Chamber's +4 m adds nothing either": "自带的无限躯干穿透尚未建模 —— 这场战斗只有一个目标，所以它不改变任何数字，双模式弹膛的 +4 米穿透同样如此"
  "Its innate punch through does not pass surfaces when the projectile's centre hits one; there are no surfaces here.": "弹体中心打到表面时，自带穿透对表面无效；这里没有表面。"
  "Its innate punch through does not pass surfaces when the projectile's centre hits one; this fight has no surfaces, so this changes nothing here.": "弹体中心打到表面时，自带穿透对表面无效；本场没有表面，所以这里没有影响。"
  "It reloads 33% of its magazine a second while holstered or deployed; it is never holstered here.": "收枪或架设时每秒自动装填 33% 弹匣；这里从不收枪。"
  "the innate {m} m punch-through is not modelled — this fight has one target, so it changes no number": "自带的 {m} 米穿透尚未建模 —— 这场战斗只有一个目标，所以它不改变任何数字"
  "The laser sight highlights weak points on screen, an aiming aid; the sim draws headshots from the fight's headshot rate.": "激光瞄具会在屏幕上标出弱点，这是瞄准辅助；模拟的爆头按战斗设定的爆头率计算。"
  "the link carries the build, its rivens, the fight it was measured in and the measurement — opening it saves a new copy of each": 链接带上了配装、它装的裂罅、测它用的那场战斗，以及测出的数字——对方打开会各存一份新的，不会覆盖他原有的
  "The mines are detonated by hand with the alt-fire, and several can be laid first (wiki). The sim detonates each on landing: the ceiling for one mine. Laying several and detonating them together is not modelled.": "地雷由副射击手动引爆，可以先布置多颗（wiki）。模拟让每颗落地即爆，这是单颗地雷的上限。先布置多颗再一起引爆的打法未建模。"
  "The mines are detonated by hand with the alt-fire, up to four at a time (wiki). The sim detonates each on landing: the ceiling for one mine. Sticking four and detonating them together is not modelled.": "地雷由副射击手动引爆，最多同时四颗（wiki）。模拟让每颗落地即爆，这是单颗地雷的上限。先粘上四颗再一起引爆的打法未建模。"
  "The miniature rifles lock onto up to four enemies within 40 degrees and 10 m, paying ammo per target (wiki). The engine fires at the aimed body only: right against one enemy, up to four times low against a crowd.": "微型步枪会锁定 40 度、10 米内最多四个敌人，每个目标都消耗弹药（wiki）。引擎只朝瞄准的目标开火：对单个敌人是准确的，面对人群最多偏低四倍。"
  "The missiles home, which is not modelled; with one target at zero distance, homing and straight missiles land the same.": "导弹会追踪，未建模；只有一个零距离目标时，追踪与直射的命中结果相同。"
  "The mode is charged by dealing damage with the primary fire; the engine has no way for one mode to pay for another.": "这个模式需要用主射击造成伤害来充能；引擎无法让一个模式为另一个模式付费。"
  "The alt-fire's third attack, a burn in 6 m between the contact hit and the explosion, is not counted: the engine carries one direct hit and one explosion per attack. The number reads low.": "副射击的第三段攻击（接触命中与爆炸之间、6 米内的灼烧）未计入：引擎每次攻击只带一次直击和一次爆炸。数字偏低。"
  "The module's third attack, 'Infested Harpoon Contact', is the damage dealt while the target is held, a state the engine does not track; it is not counted.": "模块中的第三段攻击「Infested Harpoon Contact」是目标被定住期间造成的伤害，引擎不追踪这种状态，所以未计入。"
  "The module gives this shot three attacks and the engine carries one explosion: the Blast collapse is modelled, and the initial blast is not - neither its 10 Cold damage nor its guaranteed Cold status in 7.2 m, so a build that profits from Cold stacks or a status count reads low.": "模块给这一发三段攻击，而引擎只带一次爆炸：爆炸伤害的坍缩已建模，初始爆炸未建模——它的 10 冰冻伤害和 7.2 米内必定触发的冰冻状态都没有计入，所以吃冰冻层数或状态数量加成的配置读数偏低。"
  "The collapse's 1.3 s delay after the initial blast is not modelled: the blast arrives with the arrow, so a short fight gets its damage early.": "初始爆炸后 1.3 秒才坍缩，这段延迟未建模：爆炸与箭矢同时到达，所以短时间的战斗拿到伤害的时间偏早。"
  "The module gives this shot three attacks and the engine carries one explosion: the Blast collapse is modelled, and the initial blast is not - neither its Cold damage nor its guaranteed Cold status in 7.2 m, so a build that profits from Cold stacks or a status count reads low.": "模块给这一发三段攻击，而引擎只带一次爆炸：爆炸伤害的坍缩已建模，初始爆炸未建模——它的冰冻伤害和 7.2 米内必定触发的冰冻状态都没有计入，所以吃冰冻层数或状态数量加成的配置读数偏低。"
  "the official rulers — the same fight on every weapon": 官方标尺 —— 每把武器都是同一场战斗
  "the official test scenario — the same fight on every weapon, so results compare": 官方测试场景 —— 每把武器都是同一场战斗，结果之间可以比较
  "The orb hangs in place and damages what walks into it, and shooting the primary fire through it adds damage (wiki). The engine fires each mode on its own, so this interaction is not modelled.": "光球会停在原地，伤害走进去的敌人；用主射击穿过它还能获得额外伤害（wiki）。引擎各模式独立开火，所以这种联动未建模。"
  "The page gives the spool as a count, 6 shots to full fire rate, not as a starting fraction, so the spool is not entered.": "页面给的转膛是发数（6 发达到最佳射速），没有起始比例，所以转膛未录入。"
  "the player does not move or aim by hand here": 这里的玩家不移动，也不手动瞄准
  "The primary fire homes on a beaconed target for 20 s (wiki); shots here already land where aimed, so homing adds nothing.": "主射击会在 20 秒内追踪被标记的目标（wiki）；这里的子弹本来就落在瞄准处，所以追踪不产生收益。"
  "the progenitor element — pool = searched, req = pin one": 始祖元素——pool 表示纳入搜索，req 表示钉死一个

  "The projectile explodes on impact or after 15 m (wiki).   "The alt-fire, a second charged shot, is not modelled: a weapon holds one charged form.   "The draw time is not published: the module gives a charge time for the alt-fire (1.50 s) and none for this attack, so the cadence is the 0.6 s nock alone.   "The projectile lives 0.6 s, and each enemy hit adds 50% to its life and size, up to 10 s (wiki). The engine stops a projectile at the first body it hits, so against a crowd the number reads low.": "弹体存在 0.6 秒，每命中一个敌人寿命和体积 +50%，最长 10 秒（wiki）。引擎让弹体在第一个命中目标处停下，所以面对人群时数字偏低。"

  "The projectile is a wall 4.4 m thick that sweeps everything in that band; the sim fires a ray, so only bodies on the line are hit and against a crowd the number reads low.": "弹体是一道 4.4 米厚的墙，会扫过这个宽度内的一切；模拟发射的是射线，只命中线上的目标，所以面对人群时数字偏低。"

  "The rocket flies at 60 m/s and can be shot down; nothing shoots back here, so every rocket arrives.": "火箭以 60 米/秒飞行，可以被打掉；这里没有东西会还击，所以每枚火箭都会命中。"

  "The rockets arm only after 7 m (wiki); closer, they hit without exploding.   "An Enkaus hit that leaves an ink-stained enemy below 35% health kills it outright, as one hit at 600% critical chance, 1x critical multiplier and a forced Corrosive status (wiki); the stain comes from the alternate fire or Follie's passive, and bosses and enemies with special states are spared.   "Primary fire on an ink-stained enemy spends no ammo and restores 0.33 rounds per enemy hit (wiki).   "The self-stagger from its own explosion at close range is not modelled; it deals the firer no damage.": "近距离自身爆炸造成的踉跄未建模；它不会伤害开火者。"
  "The semi-auto mode is entered by deploying a disc that lasts until a reload and highlights enemy heads within 20 m through walls (wiki). The sim does not use the highlight or the disc's timer, so the mode is available from the first shot.": "进入半自动模式需要部署一个圆盘，它持续到下一次换弹，并能透墙高亮 20 米内敌人的头部（wiki）。模拟不使用高亮，也不计圆盘的时间，所以这个模式从第一发起就可用。"
  "The bomblets take no Condition Overload: the wiki's catalog gives them a rule of their own ({row}), and the engine sets the rule per weapon. They read low by that term only.": "子炸弹不吃异况超量：wiki 目录给它们单独一条规则（{row}），而引擎按武器设定规则。它们只在这一项上偏低。"
  "The bomblets' forced stagger on contact is not modelled; the contact hit rolls its status chance like any other.": "子炸弹接触时的强制踉跄未建模；接触命中照常掷触发几率。"
  "The guaranteed Impact proc reaches only 9 m (further with Projectile Speed mods) but is applied at every distance here.": "必定触发的冲击只在 9 米内生效（弹速 MOD 可延长），但这里在任何距离都计算。"
  "The projectile is wide, like the Arca Plasmor's (page); the sim fires a ray, so with infinite punch through only bodies on the line are hit.": "弹体很宽，类似 Arca Plasmor（页面）；模拟发射的是射线，所以即使无限穿透，也只命中线上的目标。"
  "Punch through moves the sphere to the last point of contact (page), so a punch-through build sets it off behind the last body it passes.": "穿透会把球形范围移到最后一个接触点（页面），所以带穿透的配装会在穿过的最后一个目标后方引爆。"
  "The sac bounces up to twice and explodes on each bounce (page); only the first explosion is fired here, because where a bounce lands depends on the room.": "孢囊最多反弹两次，每次都会爆炸（页面）；这里只计第一次爆炸，因为反弹落点取决于房间。"
  "The three bomblets the sac splits into are not fired. The module lists a Bomblet Impact and a 2.1 m Bomblet Explosion, both Toxin, and nothing prices the explosion. All the chamber's Toxin goes to the first explosion, which overpays it if the bomblets share that Toxin and underpays the shot if they add to it.": "孢囊分裂出的三颗子炸弹未发射。模块列出了 Bomblet Impact 和 2.1 米的 Bomblet Explosion，都是毒素伤害，但没有任何资料给出爆炸的数值。枪膛的全部毒素都算在第一次爆炸上：如果子炸弹分享这部分毒素，这里多算了；如果是额外叠加，这里少算了。"
  "Its 42 m range is the projectile's 0.42 s lifetime, so Projectile Speed mods extend it in game; here they move the falloff and the cut-off stays at 42 m.": "42 米射程来自弹体 0.42 秒的存在时间，所以游戏里弹速 MOD 能延长射程；这里它们只移动衰减区间，截止距离仍是 42 米。"
  "Its 20 m range is the projectile's 0.42 s lifetime, so Projectile Speed mods extend it in game; here they move the falloff and the cut-off stays at 20 m.": "20 米射程来自弹体 0.42 秒的存在时间，所以游戏里弹速 MOD 能延长射程；这里它们只移动衰减区间，截止距离仍是 20 米。"
  "Eclipse's damage buff does not reach this chamber in game (wiki, Bugs); here a buff reaches every weapon, so with Eclipse up the number reads high.": "游戏里黯然失色的伤害加成对这种枪膛无效（wiki，Bugs 一节）；这里增益对所有武器都生效，所以开着黯然失色时数字偏高。"
  "The projectile has a width, smaller than the secondary's; the sim fires a ray, so with infinite punch through only bodies on the line are hit.": "弹体有宽度（比副武器的小）；模拟发射的是射线，所以即使无限穿透，也只命中线上的目标。"
  "The sphere also forms at the beam's maximum range (3 m, page); here the range is a hard limit, so a target up to 3 m beyond it takes nothing.": "在光束最大射程处也会形成球形范围（3 米，页面）；这里射程是硬上限，所以射程外 3 米内的目标什么都吃不到。"
  "Chains skip enemies already hit by the main beam (page); here a chain can hit a body the beam passed through, so the number reads high.": "连锁不会打已被主光束命中的敌人（页面）；这里连锁可以打到被光束穿过的目标，所以数字偏高。"
  "The tendrils auto-target with a slight delay before dealing damage, while ammo is spent (page); not modelled.": "触须自动索敌，造成伤害前有轻微延迟，期间仍消耗弹药（页面）；未建模。"
  "The Condition Overload catalog prices this weapon's term on a fixed 57 damage whatever the grip, which cannot be expressed as a share of the direct hit. The direct hit takes the ordinary term on its own Impact instead: none on the default Gibber grip, 261 on Haymaker.": "异况超量目录对这把武器的加成固定按 57 点伤害计算，与握把无关，这无法表达为直击的一个比例。这里改为按直击自身的冲击伤害计算常规加成：默认的 Gibber 握把为零，Haymaker 为 261。"
  "The projectile falls off from 13 m to 26 m to an unpublished amount, so no falloff is applied.": "弹体在 13 米到 26 米之间衰减，衰减到多少没有公开，所以这里不应用衰减。"
  "The sac arcs heavily, reduced by Projectile Speed; not modelled.": "孢囊弧线很大，弹速可以减小弧度；未建模。"
  "The three tendrils fan out within 6 m of the main target (page); here the chain hops 6 m from each previous enemy. Against a tight group the two agree; an enemy 6-12 m from the first is reached here and not in game.": "三条触须会在主目标 6 米范围内散开（页面）；这里的连锁则是每一跳距离上一个目标 6 米。面对密集的敌群两者一致；距离第一个目标 6–12 米的敌人，这里能打到，游戏里打不到。"
  "With punch through, chains come only from the furthest target the beam hits (page); here every body the beam crosses starts its own chain, so the number reads high.": "带穿透时，连锁只从光束命中的最远目标发出（页面）；这里光束穿过的每个目标都会各自发出连锁，所以数字偏高。"
  "The tendril auto-targets, with a noticeable delay between firing and dealing damage while ammo is spent (page); the delay is not modelled.": "触须会自动索敌，从开火到造成伤害有明显的延迟，期间仍消耗弹药（页面）；这段延迟未建模。"
  "The tendrils aim themselves at different enemies and can fail to lock, losing damage (page). All five land on the target here, which is what staying at melee range and aiming directly produces.": "触须会各自锁定不同的敌人，也可能锁定失败，损失伤害（页面）。这里五条全部命中目标，这是贴身直接瞄准时的情况。"
  "An auto-targeted tendril always aims at the enemy's centre and never headshots; only one aimed above the enemy can.": "自动索敌的触须总是瞄准敌人中心，不会爆头；只有往敌人上方瞄的那条可以。"
  "the sim does not model this yet, so its number against this target is optimistic": 模拟还没有实现这条机制，所以对这个目标算出的数字偏高
  "this result was stored without its build — run it again to send it": 这条结果保存时没有带上配装 —— 重新跑一次才能交给优化器
  "the simulator refused this build — see the build's own card": 模拟器拒绝了这套配装 —— 看它自己的卡片
  "The snare damages, paralyses for about 6 s and pulls up to 8 enemies within 15 m, the count multiplied by multishot (wiki). The engine applies it to the aimed body only, so the 40 Toxin here is all it pays.": "陷阱会造成伤害、麻痹约 6 秒，并把 15 米内最多 8 个敌人拉到一起，数量受多重射击加成（wiki）。引擎只对瞄准的目标结算，所以这里只计 40 毒素伤害。"
  "The sniper combo counter and the scope's headshot bonus are not modelled in this form. Both are on the base form, and no source says whether either survives the transform.": "狙击连击计数和瞄准镜爆头加成在这个形态中未建模。两者在基础形态上已建模，没有资料说明变身后是否保留。"
  "The spear must be picked up or waited out; here it is thrown and firing continues.": "长矛需要捡回或等待返回；这里投出后照常继续开火。"
  "The split fires a zero-damage instance that still takes its own multipliers. Faction bonuses carry down the chain as intended; a per-instance bonus such as Devouring Attrition's +2000% carries too, which is not intended (x21 twice = x441). Modelled as it behaves now; a fix would remove it.": "分裂会触发一次零伤害实例，但它仍吃自己的乘区。派系加成沿链传递是设计如此；像 Devouring Attrition 的 +2000% 这种按实例的加成也会传递，则不是设计（两次 ×21 = ×441）。这里按现在的实际表现建模，修复后会消失。"
  "The spool rebuilds after every reload. Per the page, short pauses in burst fire keep it, so a player who taps keeps more of the rate than the sim. The spool itself is modelled.": "每次换弹后转膛重新累积。按页面说法，点射的短暂停顿能保持它，所以点射的玩家能保住比模拟更高的射速。转膛本身已建模。"
  "the spool-up is not modelled — this entry fires at the fully spooled rate from the first round": 预热尚未建模 —— 这个条目从第一发就按预热完成后的射速开火
  "the stacks never expire — they still start where you set them and still build on every trigger": 层数不会过期——仍然从你设定的层数开始，也仍然会随触发继续叠加
  "the target's armour, column and attenuation": 目标的护甲、易伤列与衰减
  "The throw is silent and the cloud is not; there is nobody to alert here.": "投掷是静音的，毒云不是；这里没有会被惊动的敌人。"
  "The throw's forced knockdown is crowd control, worth time and safety rather than damage; it changes nothing here.": "投掷必定击倒属于控制效果，价值在时间和安全，不在伤害；这里没有影响。"
  "The spear must be retrieved before the weapon can be used again (wiki); the sim throws on a cadence and never retrieves it.": "长矛必须捡回后才能再次使用（wiki）；模拟按固定节奏投掷，从不捡回。"
  "Not offered here: the thrown-exclusive Concealed Explosives.": "这里不提供：投掷专属的 Concealed Explosives。"
  "Not offered here: the thrown-exclusive Concealed Explosives, a second damage source on a weapon with this fire rate.": "这里不提供：投掷专属的 Concealed Explosives；对这种射速的武器来说，它是一整个第二伤害来源。"
  "The very heavy side-to-side recoil (page) makes its accuracy hold only for the first shot; the sim has no recoil.": "很大的左右后坐力（页面）让它的精度只对第一发有效；模拟没有后坐力。"
  "The wave's wide, flat hitbox is not modelled; this fight has no geometry for it.": "波浪的宽扁判定未建模；本场没有可以表达它的几何。"
  "the weapon's printed panel": 就是武器面板上印的那样
  "the wielder's state: mods that only pay while Invisible (Spectral Serration) grant nothing when this is off": 使用者状态：只在隐身时生效的 MOD（幽魂锯齿）关掉这个就什么都不给
  "the wielder's state: what a card means by \"With Channeled Ability active\". The ability must DRAIN ENERGY over time — Desecrate, Haven and an empty Gloom do not count": 使用者状态：卡面上说的「引导类技能生效中」指的就是这个。技能必须是持续耗能的——亵渎、庇护所、以及周围没有敌人时的阴郁都不算
  "the wielder's state: what a card means by \"With Overshields\". Nothing here takes them away, so it is a declaration": 使用者状态：卡面上说的「拥有超量护盾时」指的就是这个。这里没有任何东西会打掉它，所以它是一个声明而不是战斗里的变量
  "the wielder's state: what a card means by \"while Airborne\"": 使用者状态：卡面上说的「滞空时」指的就是这个
  "the wielder's state: what a card means by \"while Sliding\" — held for the whole engagement": 使用者状态：卡面上说的「滑行时」指的就是这个——整场战斗都保持
  "the wielder's state: what a card means by \"while Aim Gliding\" — held for the whole engagement, and airborne too": 使用者状态：卡面上说的「飞身瞄准时」指的就是这个——整场战斗都保持，同时也算滞空
  "The ~0.5 s delay before the mode can lock on again after a burst is not modelled.": "连射后约 0.5 秒才能再次锁定，这段延迟未建模。"
  "these procs cannot land on this unit — the other damage types take over their share of the status roll": 这些异常打不到这个单位身上 —— 它们那份触发概率由其余伤害类型接管
  "these procs cannot land — the other types take over their share of the roll": 这些异常打不上去 —— 它们那份触发概率由其余属性接管
  "these procs still land and still count for Condition Overload — this unit simply ignores what they do": 这些触发照常上、也照常计入异况超量 —— 这个单位只是无视它们的效果
  "this ability lets you pick the element — the gear wheel in game": 这个技能可以自选元素——游戏里那个装备轮盘
  "this acts on something a weapon-damage simulator has none of — Warframe energy, enemy behaviour, movement — so it would change no number here": 它作用于武器伤害模拟器根本没有的东西——战甲能量、敌人行为、移动——所以就算实现了，这里的任何数字也不会变
  "This attack's spread is not in the data, so none of its shots miss. At range the number is the ceiling; at point blank it is unaffected.": "这次攻击的散布没有录入，所以不会打空。远距离时数字是上限；贴脸时不受影响。"
  "this browser will not copy images — use download": 这个浏览器不支持复制图片，请用下载
  "this browser will not say how many cores it has, so 4 is assumed — the share still applies": "这个浏览器不肯说自己有几个核心，所以按 4 个估算 —— 比例设置照常生效"
  "this browser's storage is full - the change is on screen but was not saved": "这个浏览器的存储空间满了 —— 改动在屏幕上，但没有保存下来"
  "this cannot pay out in a one-target fight — it is an edge of the model, not a gap in it": 这在单体战斗里不可能产生收益 —— 它是模型的边界，不是模型的缺口
  "this instance's modded damage": 这个实例改装后的伤害
  "this is as good as the top option — the gap between them is smaller than either answer's own width, so the order between them is the dice": 这个和第一名一样好——它们之间的差距比任一答案自身的误差还小，所以谁排前面是掷骰决定的
  "this is the aimed enemy, and what the place tool puts down. Enemies already on the floor keep the unit they were placed with.": "这是被瞄准的敌人，也是放置工具会放下的单位。已经在场上的敌人保持放置时的单位。"
  "this is the aimed enemy, and what the place tool puts down. {n} already on the floor keep the unit they were placed with.": "这是被瞄准的敌人，也是放置工具会放下的单位。场上已有 {n} 个保持着各自放置时的单位。"
  "this matches the live game and is a bug — DE may patch it, and the number here changes when they do": 这与现在的游戏一致，但它是个 bug——DE 随时可能修，修了这里的数字就会变
  "In game this mode is entered by aiming. The sim sets the mode and Aiming separately, so read every while-aiming bonus as active whenever this mode is.": "游戏里靠瞄准进入这个模式。模拟把模式和「瞄准」分开设置，所以只要处于这个模式，就应把所有「瞄准时」加成视为生效。"
  "this option did not re-roll the fight — run for run it scaled the same fight, so this comparison is exact": "这个选项没有让战斗重新掷骰——每一次运行它都是把同一场战斗按同一个倍数放大，所以这次比较是精确的"
  "this option re-rolls the fight, so its answer is only good to ±{x} — raise the run count to narrow it": 这个选项会让这场战斗重新掷骰，所以它的答案只精确到 ±{x} —— 提高运行次数可以收窄它
  "A reload is never interrupted here: in game you can fire mid-reload and keep the shells already loaded. A listed reload is a whole reload, by design.": "这里从不打断换弹：游戏里可以在换弹中途开火并保留已装的弹。按设计，标出的换弹就是完整的一次。"
  "this target dispels it — nothing ticked here is running against it": 这个目标会把它驱散 —— 对它而言这里勾选的都没有生效
  "this target nullifies Warframe abilities — it pulses every 5 seconds and dispels everything in range, so none of these are running and the sim scores it that way": 这个目标会驱散战甲技能 —— 它每 5 秒脉冲一次、清除范围内的一切,所以下面勾选的都没有生效,模拟也是按没有生效来算的
  "this unit's faction takes more or less of these damage types, whatever its armor and shields do": 这个单位所属阵营对这些伤害类型更脆弱或更抗性，与它的护甲和护盾无关
  "It cannot be modded here: it uses melee and thrown melee mods (Pressure Point, Fury, Whirlwind, Power Throw), which are not offered for it. Its base numbers are right; a build is not available.": "它在这里不能配 MOD：它使用近战和投掷近战 MOD（Pressure Point、Fury、Whirlwind、Power Throw），这里没有为它提供。它的基础数值是对的，只是没法配装。"
  "this weapon cannot be resupplied — once its reserve is gone it is removed for five minutes, so the setting has nothing to stand in for": 这把武器无法补给——储备打光后会被收回，五分钟后才能再次召唤，所以这个选项没有可代表的东西
  "This weapon cannot equip Concealed Explosives, the thrown-exclusive mod, which is not offered here either way.": "这把武器不能装备投掷专属的 Concealed Explosives，这里本来也不提供这张卡。"
  "This weapon does not self-stagger, unlike other explosives; the sim charges none of them for it, so this changes nothing here.": "这把武器不会造成自身踉跄，这一点不同于其他爆炸武器；模拟对它们都不计这项代价，所以这里没有影响。"
  "this weapon has no ammo reserve to run out of": 这把武器没有会耗尽的备弹
  "this weapon is never holstered during the fight": 战斗中这把武器从不收起
  "Unmeasured: when in the reload the grenade lands. The page says it is thrown mid-reload without a time, so it lands halfway through; the throw itself takes no time.": "未实测：榴弹在换弹的哪个时刻落地。页面只说在换弹中途扔出，没有给时间，所以按换弹进行到一半时落地；投掷本身不占时间。"
  "The explosion's self-stagger, which costs the wielder time when the target stands inside the blast, is not modelled.": "爆炸造成的自身踉跄未建模；目标在爆炸范围内时，它会让使用者损失时间。"
  "Galvanized Shot's bug on the grenade's direct hit (multiplicative with base damage; the Bugs section of the wiki's Catabolyst page) is not modelled.": "Galvanized Shot 对榴弹直击的 bug（与基础伤害相乘；见 wiki Catabolyst 页的 Bugs 一节）未建模。"
  "Interrupting the reload to throw again without reloading, the exploit the page describes, is not modelled.": "页面描述的打断换弹、不装填就再次投掷的技巧未建模。"
  "The 45-degree fan is read as edge to edge around the reticle; the page does not say.": "45 度扇形按以准星为中心、从一边到另一边计算；页面没有写明。"
  "This weapon never reloads on its own; the sim reloads it, so forgetting to costs nothing here.": "这把武器不会自动换弹；模拟会替你换弹，所以忘记换弹在这里没有代价。"
  "this weapon's passive is not modelled yet — the numbers below are a floor, not its full output": 这把武器的被动尚未建模——下面的数字是下限，不是它的完整输出

  "a per-PELLET aim weight on the body the shot STRUCK, not a whole-spread promise — the landing spot is rolled for each pellet, and nothing a blast or a chain reaches can be a headshot": 这是对「被射中的那个目标」的逐弹丸落点权重，不是对整发弹幕的承诺 —— 每颗弹丸各自掷一次落点，而爆炸和链打到的任何目标都不可能爆头。
  "The target is one Thrax Centurion at level 9999 on Steel Path. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": 目标是一只 9999 级钢铁之路的 Thrax Centurion。战斗持续 180 秒。
  "The target is one Thrax Centurion at level 1000 in The Icebind, a squad of six. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": 目标是一只 1000 级 Icebind（六人小队）的 Thrax Centurion。战斗持续 180 秒。
  "The target is one Thrax Centurion at level 500 in Deep Archimedea, a squad of four. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": 目标是一只 500 级 Deep Archimedea（四人小队）的 Thrax Centurion。战斗持续 180 秒。
  "The target is one Thrax Centurion at level 200 on Steel Path. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": 目标是一只 200 级钢铁之路的 Thrax Centurion。战斗持续 180 秒。
  "One target: damage that reaches other enemies counts for nothing here.": 只有一个目标：波及其他敌人的伤害在这里不计分。
  "Every shot is aimed and lands on the weak point. That is the ceiling of aim, not a claim about how most players shoot.": 每一发都瞄准并命中弱点。这是瞄准的上限，不是说大多数人都这么打。
  "The score is kills per minute, counting the fraction of the current target already gone. Removing 3% of one target in 180 seconds scores 0.03 and still ranks.": 分数是每分钟击杀数，并计入当前目标已被削去的比例。180 秒内削掉一个目标的 3%，得分 0.03，仍然进榜。
  "Every main slot is filled, every evolution tier the entry has is taken, every arcane seat it has is filled. The Exilus slot is never counted.": 每个主槽都装满，该条目拥有的每一阶进化都选，每一个赋能位都填。Exilus 槽从不计入。
  "Investment is not ranked: every entry is scored at full Forma, at max rank, and at the maximum roll of any bonus a player can raise by farming duplicates.": 投入不参与排名：每个条目都按满 Forma、满等级、以及任何可以靠刷重复品提升的加成的最大值来计分。
  "Ammo pickups are modelled. An entry that cannot be resupplied runs on its own reserve.": 弹药拾取被建模。无法补给的条目只能靠自己的备弹。
  "An entry that can be played more than one way is ranked once per way, and the way it was played is part of the row.": 一个可以有多种打法的条目，每种打法各排一次，而用哪种打法本身就是这一行的一部分。
  "A buff starts the fight FULL only if it is permanent — no timer, and not spent by being used. Such a buff can be held for the whole fight by anyone, so scoring it at anything less would rank how long ago the entrant last topped it up. Every other buff starts at zero and is earned in the fight. Two buffs in the data qualify today.": "一个 buff 只有在它是永久的时候才以满层开局 —— 没有计时，也不会因使用而消耗。这样的 buff 任何人都能全程保持，所以按低于满层计分，等于在排「投稿者上次补层是多久以前」。其余所有 buff 从零开始，在战斗中挣得。目前数据中有两个 buff 符合。"
  "Nobody submits a number. A submission is a BUILD, and its score is computed here by this engine under the pinned seed above, so any row can be reproduced exactly by anyone with the repo.": 没有人提交数字。提交的是一套配装，分数由本引擎在上面钉死的种子下算出，所以任何一行都能被拿到仓库的人精确复现。
  "The target is one Demolisher Devourer at level 9999 on Steel Path, carrying the health a four-player squad gives it. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": "目标是一只 9999 级钢铁之路的爆破型吞噬者，带着四人小队时的血量。战斗持续 180 秒。"
  "The target is one Demolisher Devourer at level 1000 in The Icebind, a squad of six, carrying the health a four-player squad gives it. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": "目标是一只 1000 级 Icebind（六人小队）的爆破型吞噬者，带着四人小队时的血量。战斗持续 180 秒。"
  "The target is one Demolisher Devourer at level 500 in Deep Archimedea, a squad of four, carrying the health a four-player squad gives it. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": "目标是一只 500 级 Deep Archimedea（四人小队）的爆破型吞噬者，带着四人小队时的血量。战斗持续 180 秒。"
  "The target is one Demolisher Devourer at level 200 on Steel Path, carrying the health a four-player squad gives it. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": "目标是一只 200 级钢铁之路的爆破型吞噬者，带着四人小队时的血量。战斗持续 180 秒。"
  "ONE WEAPON FIRES. A four-player squad is a harder TARGET here, not three more guns — this fight has one shooter — so what is ranked is how much of that Demolisher your weapon alone takes off.": "只有一把武器在开火。四人小队在这里意味着更耐打的目标，而不是多出三把枪——这个场地只有一名射手——所以排名比的是你这一把武器单独能把这只爆破使削掉多少。"
  "Every shot is aimed and every one lands on the weak point, which is worth 3x.": "每一发都瞄准，并且全部命中弱点，弱点倍率为 3 倍。"
  "Radiation cannot proc on this unit: the type is dropped from the draw, and every other type on the build gets likelier for it.": "辐射无法在这个单位上触发：抽取异常时会去掉辐射，配装上其他每种类型的触发几率都会因此变高。"
  "It can never be Frozen, so Cold climbs to its cap and stays there. An Impact proc lands and counts as a status type, and does not stagger it.": "它永远不会被冰冻，所以冷冻层数会一路叠到上限并保持。冲击异常能触发，也算作一种异常类型，但打不出硬直。"
  "The score is kills per minute, counting the fraction of the current target already gone. Removing 3% of one Demolisher in 180 seconds scores 0.03 and still ranks.": "分数是每分钟击杀数，并计入当前目标已被削去的比例。180 秒内削掉一只爆破使的 3%，得分 0.03，仍然进榜。"
  "The target is one Eximus Corrupted Heavy Gunner at level 9999 on Steel Path. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": "目标是一只 9999 级钢铁之路的卓越者堕落重型机枪手。战斗持续 180 秒。"
  "The target is one Eximus Corrupted Heavy Gunner at level 1000 in The Icebind, a squad of six. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": "目标是一只 1000 级 Icebind（六人小队）的卓越者堕落重型机枪手。战斗持续 180 秒。"
  "The target is one Eximus Corrupted Heavy Gunner at level 500 in Deep Archimedea, a squad of four. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": "目标是一只 500 级 Deep Archimedea（四人小队）的卓越者堕落重型机枪手。战斗持续 180 秒。"
  "The target is one Eximus Corrupted Heavy Gunner at level 200 on Steel Path. The fight lasts 180 seconds.": "目标是一只 200 级钢铁之路的卓越者堕落重型机枪手。战斗持续 180 秒。"
  "The target is a Corrupted Heavy Gunner because it spawns in Void Fissures, it is the toughest Orokin unit, and it is one of the targets players most often test builds on. It is Orokin, so faction mods and faction bonuses read on it, and it takes Puncture and Viral at 1.5x and Radiation at 0.5x. As an Eximus it carries Overguard in front of a health pool three and a half times an ordinary Heavy Gunner's; it is armoured; its weak points are 3x on the head and 1x elsewhere.": "选堕落重型机枪手做目标，是因为它会在虚空裂缝里出现，是堕落者里最硬的单位，也是玩家最常拿来测配装的木桩之一。它属于堕落者派系，所以派系 MOD 和派系加成对它生效；它受穿刺和病毒 1.5 倍、辐射 0.5 倍伤害。作为卓越者，它在生命值前面还有一层超宏防护，生命值是普通重型机枪手的三倍半；它有护甲；弱点是头部 3 倍、其他部位 1 倍。"
  "Which Eximus it is changes nothing here: no Eximus aura is applied, and no type that shields itself from weapons is used.": "是哪一种卓越者在这里没有区别：不计任何卓越者光环，也不使用会替自己挡武器伤害的类型。"
  "The score is kills per minute, counting the fraction of the current target already gone. Removing 3% of one Heavy Gunner in 180 seconds scores 0.03 and still ranks.": "分数是每分钟击杀数，并计入当前目标已被削去的比例。180 秒内削掉一只重型机枪手的 3%，得分 0.03，仍然进榜。"
  "Every main slot is filled, every evolution tier the entry has is taken, every arcane seat it has is filled. The Exilus slot is optional: a row may wear one and a row without one is not a lesser build, so the two sit on the same board and the better number wins.": "每个主槽都装满，该条目拥有的每一阶进化都选，每一个赋能位都填。Exilus 槽可选：配装可以装，也可以不装，不装的并不低人一等，两者在同一块榜上比，分数高的赢。"
  "The stance slot is optional too, and it is not a discount but a GRANT: a stance hands the weapon 10 mod capacity on a matching polarity, 5 on a bare slot and 4 on the wrong colour. A row without one is not a lesser build; it is a build that spent the capacity elsewhere.": "架势槽同样可选，而且它不是减免，而是赠予：架势在极性相符时给武器 10 点 MOD 容量，无极性时给 5 点，极性不符时给 4 点。不装架势的配装并不低人一等，只是把这份容量花在了别处。"
  "The reserve is not spent: every entry fires as if it were being resupplied by the squad this target was brought for, so nothing here ranks ammo economy. An entry that cannot be resupplied at all runs on its own reserve.": "备弹不消耗：每个条目开火时都当作有这只目标所针对的小队在给它补给，所以这里不比弹药经济。完全无法补给的条目只能靠自己的备弹。"
  "The melee weapon is DRAWN, not quick-melee: a card that says \"With Melee Weapon Equipped\" pays here. A build swung out of a gun is a different fight and the simulator has a switch for it; the ruler does not.": "近战武器处于抽出状态，而不是快速近战：卡面写着「With Melee Weapon Equipped」的效果在这里生效。从枪上挥出的快速近战是另一场战斗，模拟器里有开关可以切换，这把标尺没有。"
  "Its nullifying pulse is not applied. The wiki describes it dispelling every Warframe ability within 6.5 m every five seconds; it does not do so in game today, and this simulation matches the game rather than the card — so Roar, Eclipse and Nourish are up here.": "它的无效化脉冲不生效。维基说它每五秒驱散 6.5 米内的所有战甲技能；但目前游戏里它并不会这样做，而本模拟以游戏为准，不以说明为准——所以战吼、黯然失色和消化滋养在这里都是开着的。"
  "Every shot is aimed and lands on the weak point of whatever it strikes directly, including anything it punches through. A chain hop and a damage cloud cannot be a weak point hit. A BLAST detonation can: it carries the weak-point and critical multipliers of the hit that applied the stack, out to everything its 5 m sphere reaches — measured in game (MEASUREMENTS M54).": "每一发都瞄准，并命中它直接击中的目标的弱点，穿透打到的目标也算。链式跳跃和伤害云不能命中弱点。爆炸异常的引爆可以：它会把施加这层异常的那一枪的弱点倍率和暴击倍率，带给它 5 米球形范围内的所有目标——这是游戏内实测的结果（MEASUREMENTS M54）。"
  "The reserve is not spent: every entry fires as if it were being resupplied, so nothing here ranks ammo economy. An entry that cannot be resupplied at all runs on its own reserve.": "备弹不消耗：每个条目开火时都当作一直有人补给，所以这里不比弹药经济。完全无法补给的条目只能靠自己的备弹。"
  "one enemy": 只留一个
  "aim at the target": 瞄回目标
  "A polarity can be swapped between this slot and a main one — the slot stays Exilus. So its polarity counts toward any build, even one that leaves it empty.": 极性可以在这个槽和主槽之间对调 —— 槽位本身仍然是 Exilus。所以它的极性对任何配装都算数，哪怕这个槽空着。
  "Assumed: a bounce lands on a weak point 50% of the time. It can headshot (wiki), but where it lands depends on geometry the sim does not model, and no rate is published.": "假设值：反弹有 50% 落在弱点上。它可以爆头（wiki），但落点取决于模拟没有的几何，也没有公开的比例。"
  "The projectile has travel time and must be led at range (wiki). Every shot here connects instantly, so against a moving target the real hit rate is lower.": "弹体有飞行时间，远距离需要提前量（wiki）。这里每一发都瞬间命中，所以面对移动目标时，实际命中率更低。"
  "The explosion is a reverse cone that damages enemies in front of the target (page); this fight gives a blast no facing, so it is a full 1.9 m sphere. Against a crowd it reaches enemies the game would not, so the number reads high.": "爆炸是一个反向锥形，伤害目标前方的敌人（页面）；本场的爆炸没有朝向，所以按完整的 1.9 米球形计算。面对人群时它会打到游戏里打不到的敌人，所以数字偏高。"
  "The quick shot is not a form here: tapping fires a smaller explosion (1.7 m, 30-108 Radiation by grip, falloff to 75%) with the same total damage split differently, and that split is unpublished. One in-game reading would settle it.": "快速射击在这里不是一个形态：点按会打出更小的爆炸（1.7 米，按握把为 30–108 辐射伤害，衰减到 75%），总伤害不变但分配不同，而这个分配没有公开。游戏内测一次就能确定。"
  "Measured: about 10% of the orb's strikes land on a weak point (5 in 48 body hits). Where they land in a crowd depends on positions the sim does not model, so a lined-up fight beats this number and a single tall target may not reach it.": "实测：光球大约 10% 的打击落在弱点上（48 次命中中 5 次）。在人群中落点取决于站位，模拟没有建模，所以敌人排成一线时会高于这个数字，单个高大目标则可能达不到。"
  "The orb bounces off walls and the floor, and there are neither here: it drifts on at {speed} m/s, leaves a standing target behind after about three seconds, lands {open_field} of its {total} strikes and detonates out of reach. In a room it stays near its target, worth about {worth} more damage. Every number for this form reads low.": "光球会在墙和地面上反弹，而这里两者都没有：它以 {speed} 米/秒飘走，约三秒后离开站立的目标，{total} 次打击只命中 {open_field} 次，并在够不着的地方引爆。在真实房间里它会留在目标附近，大约多造成 {worth} 伤害。这个形态的所有数字都偏低。"
  "In game the blast staggers the wielder; the player has no body here, so it costs nothing.": "游戏里爆炸会让使用者踉跄；这里玩家没有身体，所以没有代价。"
  "The blast needs no line of sight. There is no cover here, so the perk adds nothing.": "爆炸不需要视线。本场没有掩体，所以这个天赋不产生额外收益。"
